dvids.title: CENTCOM Commander Completes 10-Day Trip to the Middle East
dvids.desc: Adm. Brad Cooper, commander of U.S. Central Command, completed a 10-day trip to the Middle East, Aug. 15 that included visits to six countries and to a U.S. Navy aircraft carrier operating in the Arabian Sea. (U.S. Central Command video)

dvids.title: CENTCOM Commander Completes 10-Day Trip to the Middle East
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — The commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) completed a 10-day trip to the Middle East on Aug. 15 that included visits to six countries and to a U.S. Navy aircraft carrier operating in the Arabian Sea.

dvids.title: U.S. Special Operations Command Central Celebrates Transfer of Leadership
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Special Operations Command Central (SOCCENT) held a change of command ceremony Aug. 14 in Tampa, marking the transfer of leadership from Maj. Gen. Jasper Jeffers to Rear Adm. Thomas Donovan.
